witness.tight_witness: star family {A : 1 in A}, size 2^(n-1), achieved for n=3 (size 4) and n=4 (size 8)

claim: Fragment (covers=fragment): standalone deterministic verifier, exact integer bit-arithmetic only, no imports/filesystem/network, fail-closed via def verify(witness) raising. Certifies: (a) every hereditary family on [3] has all pairwise-intersecting subfamilies of size <= 4; (b) exhaustively over all 2^16 candidate families on [4], every pairwise-intersecting family (Mathlib all-pairs convention, empty set excluded) has size <= 8 and contains at most one member of each complement pair (the fixed-point-free complement-pairing core of L1); (c) the star family achieves equality, i.e. the bound 2^(n-1) is tight. The uniform bound for all n (Chvatal's conjecture) is NOT certified.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
